mapper.select: select user.id, user.name, user.gender, user.description, user.subscribe_number, user.username, user.password, user.phone, user.email, user.experience, user_image.avatar_url, user_image.banner_url from user left join user_image on user.id = user_image.user_id where user.id = #{id} and user.is_deleted = 0
